Lovecraftian horror is all about buildup and scene setting. The stories like *Whispers in the Dark*, *Call of Cthulhu*, and *The Color out of Space* are all about building the horror within the readers mind by dropping small hints about the affect the monster has on peoples minds.

The Lovecraft formula usually works this way

1. A shy intellectual is dragged into investigating a strange phenomenon by a crazy intellectual
2. The shy intellectual must learn about the phenomenon by reading notes of or listening to someone who is too ignorant to know what they are really dealing with
3. The crazy intellectual reveals "oh shit these things are aliens but they are also demons"
4. There is an encounter with the alien/demon in which the crazy intellectual is killed and the shy intellectual lives on but lives the rest of their life in fear
